title: Horse Artist vs Chaos Dragon
description: An anthropomorphic horse wearing glasses and a white gi with a green belt sits on a wooden bench in ruined stone architecture, drawing a spiral pattern in a sketchbook with a large yellow pencil as colorful paint explodes from the page. A massive, vibrant rainbow dragon with yellow eyes and sharp teeth emerges from the sketchbook amid fire, sparks, and paint splatters, while smaller black horses gallop across its body against a stormy sky with lightning.
